verdict.headline: Launch date, rocket and site check out; the 6,200 kg mass isn't in the cited pages and Northrop Grumman says 6,500 kg.

text.original: The James Webb Space Telescope launched on 25 December 2021 on an Ariane 5 rocket from Europe's Spaceport in Kourou, French Guiana. It had a launch mass of about 6,200 kg. It is the most important telescope of its generation.

omissions.description: Published launch-mass figures differ: NASA and ESA say about 6,200 kg, Northrop Grumman about 6,500 kg.
ESA's 6,200 kg includes on-orbit consumables and the launch vehicle adaptor, not the telescope alone.

follow_ups.text: Cite NASA's Webb overview or ESA's factsheet for the launch mass instead of the current links.
